quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika isn't just one spice—there are eight official varieties ranging from delicate and sweet to fiery hot! The town of Szeged is so famous for its paprika that it has a whole museum dedicated to this beloved red spice, which has been central to Hungarian cooking since the 1700s.

short_read.title: How Hummingbirds Hover in Place
short_read.teaser: These tiny aerial acrobats can beat their wings up to 80 times per second and fly backwards—feats no other bird can match. Scientists have discovered the secret is in their unique shoulder joints and figure-eight wing pattern.

medium_read.title: The Temperate Rainforests of Olympic National Park
medium_read.teaser: The Hoh and Quinault rainforests receive up to 14 feet of rain each year, creating a magical world of moss-draped trees and delicate ferns. These rare ecosystems are among the few temperate rainforests left in the world.

long_read.title: The Language of Flowers in Victorian Times
long_read.teaser: In the 1800s, people sent secret messages through carefully chosen bouquets, with each flower carrying specific meanings. A red rose meant love, while yellow carnations conveyed disappointment—whole conversations happened without a single word spoken.

port_angeles.title: Harbor Seals at Ediz Hook
port_angeles.description: July and August are wonderful months to spot harbor seals hauled out on the beaches at Ediz Hook. These playful marine mammals often rest in groups along the sandy spit, especially during low tide when they can bask in the summer sun. Bring binoculars for the best viewing while keeping a respectful distance!

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute during flight.
puzzle_1.correct_response: That's right, Barbara! Their tiny hearts work incredibly hard to power those amazing wings!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 1200 beats per minute—their hearts are as fast as their wings!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: Their hearts actually beat about 1200 times per minute! That's about 20 times per second—faster than we can even imagine!
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: Despite their racing hearts, hummingbirds can live 3-5 years in the wild, and some species have been recorded living over 12 years. At night, they enter a hibernation-like state called torpor to conserve energy.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful, Ildiko! 'Pillangó' is such a lovely, musical word for these delicate creatures!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The word is 'pillangó'! Doesn't it sound beautiful? It almost sounds like the fluttering of wings. (Virág means flower, madár means bird, and csillag means star.)
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Hungarian has many beautiful nature words, often combining sounds that echo what they describe. The language is unique in Europe, belonging to the Finno-Ugric family rather than Indo-European languages.

puzzle_3.question: What color are the flowers of most lavender plants?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Yes, purple it is! Though lavender can also come in white and pink varieties, that beautiful purple is what gives the plant its name.
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's purple! In fact, the color 'lavender' is named after the flower's lovely purple-blue hue. Some varieties do come in white and pink, but purple is the classic color.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Lavender has been treasured for over 2,500 years, used by ancient Egyptians, Romans, and Greeks for bathing, cooking, and perfume. Its calming scent is still one of the most popular in aromatherapy today.
